items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: When I joined the band the trumpets were... Buddy Lee... he's Jonah Jones' cousin... And Jonah. ... And Jonah Jones and Buddy Lee. They all came out of Louisville.

ctx.x: Who were all the guys in that band -- this, again, I'm trying to recapture this band of McKinney's -- when you joined it?

When I joined the band the trumpets were Langston Curl -- he was playing first trumpet. Joe Smith was out but he came back -- and Buddy Lee, George Oliver Buddy Lee. And, by the way, he's Jonah Jones' cousin.

items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: So we played the Oasis... the Douglas brother, they sent him back to Kansas City... here is Willie Smith and here is Tizol and they sent Jones back home.

ctx.x: And he started to getting juicy -- the band liked to have run him crazy and he never was right after that, I don't think.

So we played the Oasis and we went across the country till we got to Omaha and played a theater concert. I looked up and here is Louie Bellson, and Charlie Smith is telling us goodbye and the Douglas brother, they sent him back to Kansas City, and here's Willie Smith and here is Tizol and they sent Jones back home.
